recovery_regression.cause: Stopped workflow remained in snapshots and receipts after its list mapping was removed; duplicate paste could not reopen it. Resuming after restart also interrupted a stale unloaded turn instead of checking its persisted terminal state.
recovery_regression.fix: Duplicate paste reopens/restores the saved mapping without replay or replacement; explicit resume checks the exact saved provider turn before interrupting.
